integrity: The general identity is derived algebraically from the quadratic forms. A standalone exact-rational verifier independently generates connected unlabeled graphs through five vertices, checks all binary fields from both the original definitions and closed formulas, confirms the 11-of-21 five-vertex census, and checks the path family.
scientific_limitations: The sharp five-vertex cutoff is for connected simple undirected neighbor graphs, unstandardized symmetric adjacency weights, and nonconstant binary fields. The regular-graph identity holds for arbitrary nonconstant real fields, but row-standardized or asymmetric weights are outside the finite classification.
title: Moran and Geary first strictly reverse on five spatial units
